raised: Nothing on the page says whether ~99% shares is sensible at age 61 (no age/risk guidance)
Top heading and bullets read as designer talk, not useful to the user
The 16 'במה הכסף מושקע' category buttons are confusing; names like מניות vs מניות סחיר, הלכה יהודית vs איסלאמית unclear
Option א table lacks returns, so can't judge whether a fund is good
Orange 'ציור בלבד' notes confused – thought rows were missing
Option ב mixed list puts shares, bonds and cash side by side; comparing them makes no sense
מט״ח column only half-understood – does 99% mean dollars, does shekel movement matter
Clock icons have unknown meaning
Dotted underlines under numbers – unclear whether clickable
'>' arrows – unclear what's behind them
101% shares figure – how can it exceed 100%
'עוד לא דווח' / 'חדש' – unclear whether a new track is risky
Unclear whether average return is before or after fee / what the user actually gets
Unclear why a מניות track has 25% מט״ח while S&P has 99%
Missing: what the fee means in shekels on a real balance
Missing: returns after fee and returns in a bad year
Missing: returns for other groups in option ג (only S&P shown)
Missing: info on withdrawing, switching, and tax after 60
Would cut the row of tabs (מקור, מדריכים…)
Would cut the 'לפי חברה / לפי מוצר' toggle
Would cut the coloured rings (redundant with numbers) and the קופה column

problems.why: None of the raised problems says the lists fail to show how the companies differ; the reader names companies only to shortlist tracks, and wanting to drop the company/product toggle is about cutting clutter.

raised: Options א and ב (including the recommended א) show no returns, so the reader can't tell what a track did with people's money or whether it is any good
Nothing on the page says whether 99% shares is sensible for someone aged 61 or close to retirement
The top heading and its bullets are written for the designers, not for the user
The 16 'במה הכסף מושקע' buttons are confusing: the differences between categories such as מניות/מניות סחיר and the two הלכה options are unclear
The orange 'ציור בלבד' notes at first made the reader think rows were missing
Option ב's single mixed list puts shares, bonds and cash side by side, which makes comparing them meaningless
The מט״ח column is only half understood: does 99% mean dollars, and does that matter?
The coloured rings repeat the numbers next to them and add nothing
The meaning of the clock icons is unclear
The dotted underlines under numbers don't show whether they can be clicked
It's unclear what is behind the '>' arrows
A shares percentage of 101% is not understood
It's unclear whether tracks marked 'עוד לא דווח' or 'חדש' are risky
It's unclear what the return actually gives the reader, since the note says it is before the fee
It's unclear why a מניות track has 25% מט״ח while an S&P track has 99%
The fee is not shown in shekels for a given savings amount
Returns after fees, and returns in bad years, are missing
Option ג shows returns only for the S&P group, not for other groups
There is no information on withdrawing, switching or tax after age 60
The reader would drop the row of tabs
The reader would drop the 'לפי חברה / לפי מוצר' toggle
The reader would drop the 'קופה' number column
